sentences.en: No one knows how he has amassed his enormous fortune.
sentences.zh: 没人知道他是如何积聚起如此巨大的财富的。

sentences.en: People amassed along the streets to watch the parade.
sentences.zh: 人们聚集在街道上观看游行。

sentences.en: He amassed a fortune in stock trading during the last boom.
sentences.zh: 他在上次牛市中通过股票交易积累了大量的财富。

mnemonic: 词根记忆：a（加强）+mass（聚集）→积聚
